title: AI Search Becomes New Engine for E-commerce Growth: Shopify Says It Is Driving More Traffic and Sales and Has Not Replaced Traditional Google
excerpt: Amid the general perception that artificial intelligence is disrupting traditional online publishing and causing declines in advertising and click-through rates
content_html:
Amid the general perception that artificial intelligence is disrupting traditional online publishing and causing declines in advertising and click-through rates, e-commerce software giant Shopify has delivered a completely different result. During the company's recent second-quarter earnings call, CEO Harley Finkelstein publicly stated that AI search has not replaced traditional search engines but has instead become a new driver of traffic and sales growth on the platform, significantly benefiting small and medium-sized merchants on the platform.

Financial data shows that Shopify performed strongly in the second quarter, with total revenue growing 36% year-over-year to $3.6 billion, exceeding Wall Street expectations; gross profit also increased 31% to $171 million. The company clearly attributed part of its unexpected business performance and revenue surge to the rapid development of AI search, noting that traffic and order volume driven by AI grew three times compared to the same period last year during the second quarter.

However, this does not mean that AI is eating into traditional search's share. Finkelstein pointed out that traditional search remains one of the largest sources of buyer traffic and is still growing, with traditional search sessions increasing 1.3 times over the past two years, still accounting for about one-third of all store sessions. In their view, AI plays more of a "complementor" role in search, and the synergistic effects between the two are becoming evident.

When discussing the efficiency of AI search, Shopify explained that traditional search engines primarily rely on keywords and popularity for ranking, while AI agents can directly access a vast product catalog and rich structured data to accurately match complex buyer intent. For example, when users search for products with specific specifications, AI agents consider multiple constraints to filter truly applicable products, rather than simply relying on keyword rankings.

This deep intent matching leads to higher conversion efficiency. Data shows that about half of AI-driven sessions directly lead to product detail pages, a conversion rate 2.5 times higher than that of traditional search. Additionally, 75% of AI-related purchases occur in long-tail products outside the top 100 popular categories, benefiting more small and medium-sized merchants. Currently, Shopify has connected with numerous AI tools and vibe-coding platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Manus, Replit, and Vercel, continuously deepening its layout in the AI transaction ecosystem.

content_html_zh:
人们普遍认为人工智能正在颠覆传统在线出版并导致广告和点击率下降，但电子商务软件巨头 Shopify 却给出了完全不同的结果。 在该公司最近的第二季度财报电话会议上，首席执行官 Harley Finkelstein 公开表示，人工智能搜索并没有取代传统搜索引擎，而是成为平台流量和销售增长的新驱动力，使平台上的中小商家受益匪浅。

财务数据显示，Shopify第二季度表现强劲，总收入同比增长36%至36亿美元，超出华尔街预期；毛利润也增长了 31%，达到 1.71 亿美元。 该公司明确将业务表现和收入大幅增长的意外部分归功于人工智能搜索的快速发展，并指出第二季度人工智能驱动的流量和订单量较去年同期增长了三倍。

然而，这并不意味着人工智能正在蚕食传统搜索的份额。 Finkelstein指出，传统搜索仍然是最大的买家流量来源之一，并且仍在增长，过去两年传统搜索会话增加了1.3倍，仍然占所有商店会话的约三分之一。 在他们看来，AI在搜索中更多地扮演着“补充者”的角色，两者之间的协同效应日益明显。

在讨论人工智能搜索的效率时，Shopify解释说，传统搜索引擎主要依靠关键词和热门度进行排名，而人工智能代理可以直接访问海量的产品目录和丰富的结构化数据，以准确匹配复杂的买家意图。 例如，当用户搜索特定规格的产品时，AI代理会考虑多重约束来过滤真正适用的产品，而不是简单地依赖关键字排名。

这种深度的意图匹配可以带来更高的转化效率。 数据显示，大约一半的人工智能驱动的会话直接导向产品详情页面，转化率比传统搜索高2.5倍。 此外，75%的人工智能相关购买发生在前100名热门品类之外的长尾产品中，更多中小商户受益。 目前，Shopify已对接Claude、ChatGPT、Perplexity、Manus、Replit、Vercel等众多AI工具和vibe-coding平台，不断深化在AI交易生态的布局。
